#+title: Stop check runs leaving generated files dirty in the working tree
#+description: compass check regenerates and compares, and on this environment the comparison leaves files modified: ores.refdata.api/domain/calendar_rule.hpp, then wire-protocol configuration_document_protocol.ts, then curve_bootstrap_config_protocol.ts, each appearing as modified within a minute of the others and sometimes showing an empty diff. Two files had to be reverted by hand in one session, and a generated header's reversion nearly went into a commit. The tree should be unchanged after a read-only check, or the check should name every file it wrote.
